question: How many customers live in Pune?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE city = 'Pune'

question: Which customers spent more than 10,000 last month?
evidence: last month refers to October 2026; spending only counts completed orders; return customer names
SQL: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-31' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING SUM(o.total_amount) > 10000

question: What is the total revenue from Electronics products in completed orders in 2026?
SQL: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE p.category = 'Electronics' AND o.status = 'completed' AND strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = '2026'

question: Which product category sold the most units in completed orders?
SQL: SELECT p.category FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the names of customers who have never placed an order.
SQL: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE customer_id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders)

question: What is the average completed order value for each customer segment?
SQL: SELECT c.segment, AVG(o.total_amount) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.segment

question: How many orders had at least one payment made by UPI?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM payments WHERE method = 'upi'

question: What percentage of all orders were cancelled?
SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM orders

question: Which city has the most Corporate customers?
SQL: SELECT city FROM customers WHERE segment = 'Corporate' GROUP BY city ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many distinct customers bought at least one Books product in a completed order?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE p.category = 'Books' AND o.status = 'completed'

question: What was the total value of refunded orders placed in September 2026?
SQL: SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM orders WHERE status = 'refunded' AND order_date LIKE '2026-09-%'

question: For completed orders, what is the total amount actually received through payments in Mumbai?
evidence: payments can be split into several instalments
SQL: SELECT SUM(pay.amount) FROM payments pay JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = pay.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND c.city = 'Mumbai'
